summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Portal Arsip Digital Inspektorat. All backend APIs (44/44) and frontend features tested successfully. Authentication, RBAC, CRUD operations, and route protection working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: All 44 API tests passed (100% success rate)
Backend: Admin & auditor login with correct credentials
Backend: Wrong credentials return 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me returns user info with valid token
Backend: POST /api/auth/change-password validates old password
Backend: GET /api/users (admin only) - auditor gets 403
Backend: POST /api/users creates user, validates duplicate username
Backend: PATCH /api/users updates user, prevents admin self-deactivation/role change
Backend: POST /api/users/{id}/reset-password works for admin
Backend: DELETE /api/users prevents admin from deleting self
Backend: GET /api/news works for all authenticated users
Backend: POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/news (admin only) - auditor gets 403
Backend: GET /api/stats works for all authenticated users
Backend: PUT /api/stats (admin only) - auditor gets 403
Backend: GET /api/links works for all authenticated users
Backend: PUT /api/links (admin only) - auditor gets 403
Backend: All protected endpoints return 401 without token
Frontend: Login page displays 2 logos (Rokan Hilir + Inspektorat)
Frontend: Login form with username, password, submit button
Frontend: Wrong password displays error message
Frontend: Successful admin login redirects to dashboard
Frontend: Dashboard welcome banner with personal greeting
Frontend: 4 KPI cards display correct values (100, 80, 500, 5)
Frontend: 6 menu cards (Irban I-V + KKA) with correct status badges
Frontend: Irban 1, 4, KKA show 'Aktif' badge
Frontend: Irban 2, 3, 5 show 'Segera Hadir' badge
Frontend: News feed displays 2 seeded articles
Frontend: News detail dialog opens on 'Baca selengkapnya' click
Frontend: Header user menu shows Profile, Admin (for admin), Logout
Frontend: Profile page displays password change form (old, new, confirm, save)
Frontend: Admin panel accessible at /admin/users, /admin/news, /admin/stats, /admin/links
Frontend: Admin users page shows user table with admin and auditor
Frontend: Auditor login successful
Frontend: Auditor dashboard displays correctly
Frontend: Auditor user menu does NOT show admin link
Frontend: Route protection: auditor redirected to /dashboard when accessing /admin/*
Frontend: Clicking inactive menu card shows toast 'Aplikasi ini sedang dipersiapkan'
UI: Indonesian formal language throughout the application
UI: Green color scheme (Rokan Hilir) visible in branding
UI: Clean, professional design with proper spacing and layout
